# downsocial Facebook Video Downloader
> Free online tool to download Facebook Videos, Reels, Watch clips, and Stories in HD MP4 and MP3 without watermarks or login.

## Canonical URL
- https://downsocial.net/facebook-downloader/

## Documentation & Full Information
- Full specification: https://downsocial.net/facebook-downloader/llms-full.txt
- Terms of Service: https://downsocial.net/facebook-downloader/terms.html
- Privacy Policy: https://downsocial.net/facebook-downloader/privacy.html
- About Service: https://downsocial.net/facebook-downloader/about.html

## Key Capabilities
- Facebook Video Downloader (HD 1080p, 720p, SD MP4)
- Facebook Reels Downloader with original audio
- Facebook Watch & Live Broadcast (finished) Downloader
- Facebook to MP3 Audio extraction (192kbps - 320kbps)
- No account login, zero cookies, zero permanent server storage
- No watermarks added to downloaded files
- Fully responsive across iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows
